questions.question: Ssenariy: p99 latency 10 soniyaga chiqdi, lekin CPU, xotira va DB metrikalari normal. Tracing bilan root cause'ni qanday topasiz?
questions.explanation: Tempo'da incident oynasida duration > 5s va status 200 bo'lgan trace'larni filtrlash.

questions.question: Ssenariy: Prometheus har kuni 9:00 da OOM. Xotira portlashini qanday tekshirib tuzatasiz?
questions.explanation: GET /api/v1/status/tsdb — eng ko'p label kombinatsiyasiga ega metrika.

questions.question: OpenTelemetry va Kafka bilan yuqori throughput'li enterprise observability pipeline'ini loyihalang.
questions.explanation: [ App Pods (OTel SDK) ] ➔ [ Local OTel Collector DaemonSet ]

questions.question: Ssenariy: container log'lari sabab node diski 100%, pod'lar evict, kubelet ishlamayapti. Qanday tiklaysiz va qaytarilmasligini ta'minlaysiz?
questions.explanation: Darhol: eski log arxivlarini o'chirish (find /var/log/pods -name ".gz" -delete), crictl rmi --prune.

questions.question: 99.9% SLO uchun to'liq multi-window multi-burn-rate alert qoidasini yozing.
questions.explanation: groups:

questions.question: Asinxron Kafka navbatlari bo'ylab end-to-end trace korrelyatsiyasini qanday qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Producer: trace kontekstini Kafka record header'lariga (traceparent) inject qiladi.

questions.question: Grafana Synthetic Monitoring nima va Prometheus bilan qanday integratsiyalashadi?
questions.explanation: Global nuqtalardan HTTP, DNS, TCP, SSL probe'larini bajarib, natijani Prometheus metrikasi (probe_success, probe_duration_seconds) sifatida yozadi — yagona alerting.

questions.question: Parca va Pyroscope (eBPF continuous profiling) solishtiring.
questions.explanation: Ikkalasi ham eBPF bilan mashinadagi barcha process'larning CPU stack'larini qat'iy chastotada ~1% dan kam overhead bilan, kod o'zgartirmasdan sample qiladi — kernel va userspace birga. Pyroscope SDK orqali allokatsiya...

questions.question: Ssenariy: Alertmanager config'ga noto'g'ri sintaksis kiritilib prod alert'lar buzildi. Observability as Code uchun CI/CD qanday quriladi?
questions.explanation: Barcha dashboard, rule va Alertmanager config'larini Git'da saqlash.

questions.question: DB span'lari uchun OTel semantic conventions qanday?
questions.explanation: Standart atributlar: db.system="postgresql", db.namespace (eski db.name), db.query.text (eski db.statement, parametrlarsiz!), db.operation.name.

questions.question: Prometheus staleness handling nima?
questions.explanation: Target series chiqarishni to'xtatsa yoki scrape yiqilsa Prometheus series'ga staleness marker qo'yadi; marker'siz holatda 5 daqiqalik lookback tugagach series yo'qoladi — grafikda yolg'on tekis chiziq chizilmaydi.

questions.question: Loki chunk compaction nima?
questions.explanation: Bir xil kunning mayda chunk/index fayllarini kattaroqlarga birlashtirish — so'rov tezlashadi, object storage API xarajati kamayadi.

questions.question: Alertmanager `matchers` va eski `match_re` farqi.
questions.explanation: matchers: [severity = critical, team =~ "pay."] — zamonaviy sintaksis, =, !=, =~, !~ ni qo'llaydi.

questions.question: OTel span kind (`SERVER`, `CLIENT`, `PRODUCER`, `CONSUMER`, `INTERNAL`) nima?
questions.explanation: SERVER: kiruvchi sinxron request.

questions.question: Prometheus native histograms nima?
questions.explanation: Kodda qat'iy le chegaralarisiz eksponensial bucket'lar — rezolyutsiya dinamik, storage kam, quantile aniqligi yuqori.

questions.question: Grafana Canvas panel nima?
questions.explanation: Jonli metrika qiymatlari ustiga arxitektura sxemasi, server rack yoki tarmoq topologiyasini chizish imkonini beradigan panel.

questions.question: OTel batch processor nima?
questions.explanation: Span, log va metrikalarni tarmoqqa yuborishdan oldin batch'laydi (send_batch_size: 1024, timeout: 1s) — throughput oshadi, overhead kamayadi.

questions.question: LogQL'da `line_format` nima?
questions.explanation: Log matnini so'rov paytida qayta formatlash: | line_format "{{.timestamp}} - {{.level}} - {{.message}}" (Go template).

questions.question: Prometheus external labels nima?
questions.explanation: Prometheus instance chiqaradigan (remote write/federation/alert) barcha metrikaga qo'shiladigan global label'lar (cluster="us-east-1-prod") — Thanos/Mimir'da klasterlarni ajratish va HA dedup uchun.

questions.question: Grafana notification policies nima?
questions.explanation: Alert label'lariga ko'ra qaysi contact point (Slack, Opsgenie, webhook) xabar olishini belgilaydigan ichma-ich policy daraxti.

questions.question: Tail sampling'da probabilistic policy nima?
questions.explanation: Muvaffaqiyatli, tez request'larning qat'iy foizini (masalan 1%) saqlash — 100% xato trace'lar bilan birga normal trafik bazasi ham bo'ladi.

questions.question: Loki retention qanday sozlanadi?
questions.explanation: Compactor'da retention yoqilib (retention_enabled: true, retention_period: 30d, tenant/stream bo'yicha ham) eski chunk'lar avtomatik o'chiriladi (eski usul — table_manager).

questions.question: Prometheus target down alert'i qanday?
questions.explanation: up == 0 2 daqiqa davom etsa alert — yiqilgan target yoki exporter'ni darhol aniqlash.

questions.question: OTel redaction processor nima?
questions.explanation: Span atributlari va log'lardan sezgir PII (karta raqami, parol, token) ni eksportdan oldin avtomatik mask qiladi yoki olib tashlaydi.

questions.question: Trace'dan metrika generatsiyasi (span metrics) nima?
questions.explanation: Span'lardan real vaqtda RED metrikalarini (request rate, xato, latency histogram) avtomatik hosil qilish (Tempo metrics-generator, OTel spanmetrics connector).

questions.question: Prometheus mmap'dan qanday foydalanadi?
questions.explanation: TSDB chunk block'larini OS virtual xotirasi (mmap) orqali o'qiydi — heap'da ikki marta nusxa saqlanmaydi, page cache ishlaydi.

questions.question: Mimir multi-tenancy qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: X-Scope-OrgID header bilan tenant'lar qat'iy ajratiladi — metrika, rule va limitlar tenant bo'yicha.

questions.question: OTel span events nima?
questions.explanation: Span ichidagi vaqt belgili mikro-hodisalar ("cache_miss", "token_validated", exception) atributlar bilan.

questions.question: Blackbox exporter bilan SSL muddati alert'i qanday?
questions.explanation: Sertifikat 14 kundan kam qolganda:

questions.question: Loki so'rovida pipeline tartibi qanday bo'lishi kerak?
questions.explanation: Unumdorlik uchun: label matcher ({app="api"}) → line filter (|= "error") → parser (| json) → label filter (| status_code >= 500). Arzon filtrlar avval — parse qilinadigan qatorlar kamayadi.

questions.question: OTel Prometheus remote write exporter nima?
questions.explanation: OTel metrikalarini Prometheus remote write protobuf'ga tarjima qilib Prometheus/Mimir'ga yuboradi.

questions.question: `scrape_timeout` nima?
questions.explanation: Target /metrics javobini kutishning maksimal vaqti; oshsa scrape yiqilgan deb (up=0) yoziladi. scrape_interval dan oshmasligi kerak.

questions.question: Grafana plugin arxitekturasi qanday?
questions.explanation: Modulli kengaytmalar: data source plugin (yangi DB), panel plugin (custom grafik), app plugin (integratsiyalashgan to'plam).

questions.question: Alertmanager `repeat_interval` nima?
questions.explanation: Hali ishlayotgan alert uchun xabarni qayta yuborishdan oldin kutish vaqti (masalan 4 soat).

questions.question: OTel SDK TracerProvider nima?
questions.explanation: Ilova ichidagi Tracer'lar, span processor'lar, sampler va exporter'larni boshqaradigan registry obyekti; shutdown'da flush qilish kerak.

questions.question: PromQL'da `=~` va `!~` farqi.
questions.explanation: =~: label regex'ga mos keladi (to'liq moslik — ^...$ avtomatik).

questions.question: Grafana Explore rejimi nima?
questions.explanation: Saqlangan dashboard'larni o'zgartirmasdan ad-hoc debug: Loki log tahlili, Tempo trace, PromQL tadqiqoti.

questions.question: Alertmanager `group_wait` nima?
questions.explanation: Yangi guruhning birinchi xabarini yuborishdan oldin bog'liq alert'larni yig'ish uchun kutish (masalan 30s).

questions.question: Jaeger exporter'ning eskirishi nima degani?
questions.explanation: Jaeger endi OTLP'ni nativ qabul qiladi; Jaeger client SDK'lari va maxsus exporter eskirgan — standart OTel SDK + OTLP ishlatiladi.

questions.question: Prometheus parallel so'rovlar limiti nima?
questions.explanation: query.max-concurrency (va timeout) — bir vaqtdagi PromQL so'rovlar sonini cheklab, og'ir dashboard'lar sabab xotira tugashining oldini oladi.

questions.question: Grafana Live nima?
questions.explanation: Doimiy WebSocket ulanishlar orqali jonli metrika yangilanishlarini panellarga push qiluvchi streaming.

questions.question: Alertmanager `group_interval` nima?
questions.explanation: Allaqachon xabar yuborilgan guruhga yangi alert qo'shilganda keyingi xabardan oldin kutish (masalan 5 daqiqa).

questions.question: Trace context injection va extraction farqi.
questions.explanation: Injection: chiquvchi HTTP/gRPC so'rovga traceparent header yozish.

questions.question: Range vector va instant vector farqi.
questions.explanation: Instant vector: har series uchun bitta joriy qiymat (http_requests_total).

questions.question: Grafana dashboard version history nima?
questions.explanation: Dashboard'ning har saqlanishini kuzatuvchi ichki versiyalash — diff va bir bosishda rollback.

questions.question: Alertmanager webhook payload tuzilishi qanday?
questions.explanation: Standart JSON: alert'lar ro'yxati, status (firing/resolved), label'lar, annotation'lar, startsAt/endsAt, groupKey — tashqi incident tizimlariga.

questions.question: OTel instrumentation scope nima?
questions.explanation: Span'ni qaysi kutubxona yoki modul yaratganini aniqlaydi (masalan io.opentelemetry.spring-webmvc) — nomi va versiyasi.

questions.question: Prometheus `labeldrop` action nima?
questions.explanation: Relabeling paytida regex'ga mos label'larni tashlaydi — TSDB cardinality'ni kamaytirish uchun (label tashlangach series'lar to'qnashmasligini tekshiring).

questions.question: Grafana organization multi-tenancy nima?
questions.explanation: Grafana ichida dashboard, data source va foydalanuvchilarni mustaqil organizatsiyalarga mantiqan ajratish.

questions.question: Alertmanager notification template nima?
questions.explanation: Slack, email va webhook xabarlarini boy va o'qiladigan formatga keltiradigan Go text/template ta'riflari.

questions.question: OTel'ning Zipkin bilan mosligi qanday?
questions.explanation: OTel collector eski B3 propagation header'lari va Zipkin JSON span'larini qabul qilib standart OTLP'ga aylantiradi — bosqichma-bosqich migratsiya.

questions.question: Prometheus counter reset'larni qanday boshqaradi?
questions.explanation: rate() va increase() counter qiymati kamayganini (process restart) aniqlab, reset'ni avtomatik tuzatadi — shuning uchun counter'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ayirma emas, shu funksiyalar ishlatiladi.

questions.question: Grafana library panels nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta dashboard bo'ylab ulashiladigan panellar — bittasini o'zgartirsangiz hammasida yangilanadi.

questions.question: Alertmanager silence muddati tugashi qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Silence belgilangan tugash vaqtidan keyin avtomatik o'chadi — alert'lar qo'lsiz qaytadan page qiladi.

questions.question: OTel span links nima?
questions.explanation: Span'ni bir yoki bir nechta boshqa trace span'lari bilan bog'lash — batch ishlov va event streaming'dagi sabab munosabatlari (bitta consumer span ko'p producer'ga).

questions.question: Prometheus subquery (`rate(v[1m])[30m:1m]`) nima?
questions.explanation: Instant so'rov natijasi ustidan tarixiy oynada range so'rov — masalan max_over_time(rate(x[1m])[30m:1m]) (qimmat — recording rule afzal).

questions.question: Grafana'da cloud monitoring integratsiyasi nima?
questions.explanation: AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor va Google Cloud Monitoring metrikalarini IAM integratsiyasi orqali Grafana'da nativ ko'rish.

questions.question: Alertmanager HA gossip protokoli nima?
questions.explanation: Alertmanager instance'lari gossip (9094 port) orqali faol alert, silence va notification holatini sinxronlaydi — dublikat xabarlar yo'q.

questions.question: OTel logs data model nima?
questions.explanation: Standart log modeli: Timestamp, ObservedTimestamp, SeverityNumber, SeverityText, Body, Attributes, TraceId, SpanId.

questions.question: Relabel action `keep` nima?
questions.explanation: Regex'ga mos kelmagan target yoki series'larni tashlaydi (faqat moslar qoladi).

questions.question: Grafana public dashboards nima?
questions.explanation: Autentifikatsiyasiz ochiladigan read-only public URL — sezgir ma'lumot oqishidan ehtiyot.

questions.question: Alertmanager PagerDuty integratsiyasi qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Events API v2 ga incident yuboradi; Prometheus alert'ni resolved qilsa PagerDuty'da ham avtomatik yopiladi (dedup key orqali).

questions.question: OTel Collector filelog receiver nima?
questions.explanation: Diskdagi container log fayllarini tail qilib, parse va multiline yig'ish bilan bevosita qabul qiladi — alohida log daemon kerak emas.

questions.question: Relabel action `replace` nima?
questions.explanation: Source label'lardan regex va interpolatsiya bilan target label qiymatini yaratadi yoki ustidan yozadi.

questions.question: Tempo qidiruvi (TraceQL) nima?
questions.explanation: Trace'larni duration, status, span nomi va custom atributlar bo'yicha object storage'dan qidirish ({ span.http.status_code >= 500 && duration > 2s }).

questions.question: Alertmanager Slack integratsiyasi qanday sozlanadi?
questions.explanation: Severity bo'yicha rang, sarlavha, runbook havolalari bilan template'langan xabarlar Slack kanallariga.

questions.question: OTel exporter retry va backoff nima?
questions.explanation: Backend'ga yuborish yiqilsa queue'da buferlab exponential backoff bilan qayta urinadi — vaqtinchalik tarmoq uzilishlariga chidamlilik (queue to'lsa ma'lumot tashlanadi).

questions.question: `/api/v1/query_range` nima?
questions.explanation: PromQL'ni vaqt oralig'ida (start, end, step) baholaydi — grafik chizish uchun.

questions.question: Grafana Enterprise RBAC nima?
questions.explanation: Papka va data source darajasida nozik rollar (viewer, editor, admin, custom).

questions.question: Alertmanager Opsgenie integratsiyasi nima?
questions.explanation: Alert'larni Opsgenie API'ga dinamik prioritet bilan (critical → P1, warning → P3) yuborish.

questions.question: OTel spanmetrics nima?
questions.explanation: Span'lardan oqimda Prometheus RED metrikalarini (soni, xato, latency histogram) generatsiya qiladi (hozir connector sifatida).

questions.question: `/api/v1/query` nima?
questions.explanation: PromQL'ni bitta vaqt nuqtasida baholaydi — stat panellar va alert qoidalari uchun.

questions.question: Grafana OnCall nima?
questions.explanation: Grafana'ga integratsiyalangan on-call va paging tool'i: escalation chain'lar va jadvallar.

questions.question: Alertmanager Telegram integratsiyasi nima?
questions.explanation: Bot token orqali Telegram guruhlariga real vaqt incident va resolved xabarlari (telegram_configs).

questions.question: HTTP uchun OTel semantic conventions qanday?
questions.explanation: http.request.method="POST", http.response.status_code=200, url.full, http.route (latency'ni route bo'yicha guruhlash uchun — to'liq URL emas).

questions.question: Prometheus chunk encoding (Gorilla/XOR) nima?
questions.explanation: Ketma-ket timestamp'larni double-delta, qiymatlarni XOR bilan siqadi — sample'ga ~1.3-1.5 bayt.

questions.question: Grafana k6 nima?
questions.explanation: JavaScript'da yoziladigan dasturchi-markazli load testing tool'i; natijalarni Prometheus/Grafana'ga real vaqtda chiqaradi.

questions.question: Alertmanager auto-resolve nima?
questions.explanation: Prometheus alert'ni yubormay qo'ysa (yoki resolved yuborsa) resolve_timeout dan keyin [RESOLVED] xabari (send_resolved: true).

questions.question: OTel routing (processor/connector) nima?
questions.explanation: Atribut yoki header'ga ko'ra telemetriyani turli exporter'larga yo'naltirish (masalan tenant bo'yicha).

questions.question: Relabel action `hashmod` nima?
questions.explanation: Label qiymati hash'ining moduli bo'yicha target'larni bir nechta Prometheus orasida bo'lish — gorizontal sharding.

questions.question: Loki uchun multi-line log parsing qanday?
questions.explanation: Java/Python stack trace'larini bitta event'ga yig'ish — Promtail/Alloy yoki Fluent Bit'da multiline stage regex bilan.

questions.question: Alertmanager MS Teams integratsiyasi nima?
questions.explanation: Teams webhook kanallariga strukturali incident kartalari yuborish (msteams_configs).

questions.question: OTel Collector Prometheus receiver nima?
questions.explanation: Prometheus scrape konfiguratsiyasini collector ichida qayta ishlatib Kubernetes pod va endpoint'lardan metrika tortish.

questions.question: PromQL'da `> bool` nima?
questions.explanation: Filtrlash o'rniga har series uchun shart rost bo'lsa 1, aks holda 0 qaytaradi.

questions.question: Grafana Faro nima?
questions.explanation: Brauzer web vitals, xato va trace'larini yig'ib OTel collector'ga yuboradigan ochiq JS RUM SDK.

questions.question: Inhibit rule'dagi target matchers nima?
questions.explanation: Source alert ishlayotganda o'chiriladigan past darajadagi alert'larni tanlovchi matcher'lar.

questions.question: OTel `k8sattributes` processor nima?
questions.explanation: API Server'ni so'rab telemetriyaga pod nomi, namespace, node va deployment label'larini avtomatik qo'shadi.

questions.question: PromQL `offset` modifikatori nima?
questions.explanation: Baholash vaqtini orqaga suradi (http_requests_total offset 1w) — joriy qiymatni o'tgan hafta bilan solishtirish.

questions.question: Grafana data links nima?
questions.explanation: Panellarda vaqt oralig'i va label o'zgaruvchilarini uzatadigan bosiladigan havolalar (boshqa dashboard yoki tashqi URL).

questions.question: Alertmanager `continue: true` nima?
questions.explanation: Alert birinchi mos route'da to'xtamasdan keyingi aka-uka route'larga ham mos kelishda davom etadi (masalan Slack'ga ham, PagerDuty'ga ham).

questions.question: OTLP portlari qanday?
questions.explanation: — OTLP gRPC; 4318 — OTLP HTTP/protobuf.

questions.question: PromQL `label_join()` nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta label qiymatini ajratuvchi bilan bitta yangi label'ga birlashtiradi.

questions.question: Grafana alert holatlari (`Normal`, `Pending`, `Firing`, `NoData`, `Error`) nima?
questions.explanation: Normal: chegarada.

questions.question: Alertmanager webhook TLS tekshiruvi nima?
questions.explanation: HTTPS webhook'larga yuborishda sertifikat validatsiyasini majburlash (tls_config) — insecure_skip_verify ishlatmang.

questions.question: TraceIdRatio sampler'ning parent bilan munosabati qanday?
questions.explanation: ParentBased sampler bilan: parent sample qilingan bo'lsa child ham sample qilinadi (ratio'dan qat'i nazar) — trace waterfall uzilmaydi.

questions.question: PromQL `label_replace()` nima?
questions.explanation: Source label'dan regex bilan qism ajratib target label'ni yaratadi yoki ustidan yozadi.

questions.question: Grafana'da so'rov xatosi holatini boshqarish nima?
questions.explanation: So'rov timeout/xato bo'lganda alert Error/Alerting holatiga o'tadimi yoki oldingi holatni saqlaydimi (KeepLast) — shovqin va o'tkazib yuborish orasidagi tanlov.

questions.question: Inhibit rule'dagi source matchers nima?
questions.explanation: Past darajadagilarni bostiradigan yuqori darajali alert'ni belgilovchi matcher'lar (equal label'lari bilan bir xil node/klaster doirasida).

questions.question: OTel memory ballast (eski) nima?
questions.explanation: Go'da GC chastotasini barqarorlashtirish uchun soxta katta byte slice; endi GOMEMLIMIT bilan almashtirilgan.

questions.question: PromQL `time()` nima?
questions.explanation: Joriy Unix vaqtini soniyalarda qaytaradi — o'tgan vaqtni hisoblash uchun (time() - process_start_time_seconds).

questions.question: Grafana contact point nima?
questions.explanation: Alert xabari yetkaziladigan manzil (Slack kanal, email, PagerDuty key).

questions.question: Alertmanager matcher operatorlari qanday?
questions.explanation: =: aniq tenglik.

questions.question: OTel transform processor (OTTL) nima?
questions.explanation: OpenTelemetry Transformation Language — collector pipeline'ida maydon va atributlarni o'zgartirish, qo'yish, o'chirish.

questions.question: PromQL `timestamp()` nima?
questions.explanation: Instant vector'dagi har sample'ning aniq timestamp'ini qaytaradi (masalan oxirgi muvaffaqiyatli job vaqti).

questions.question: Grafana thresholds nima?
questions.explanation: Stat panel va gauge'larda qiymatga ko'ra rangli chegaralar (yashil, sariq, qizil).

questions.question: Alertmanager default receiver nima?
questions.explanation: Routing daraxti ildizidagi, hech qaysi child route'ga mos kelmagan alert'lar uchun zaxira kanal.

questions.question: W3C `baggage` header nima?
questions.explanation: Tarmoq hop'lari orqali vergul bilan ajratilgan key-value'larni tashuvchi header (baggage: userId=alice,tier=gold).

questions.question: PromQL `changes()` nima?
questions.explanation: Oyna davomida qiymat necha marta o'zgarganini qaytaradi (masalan config reload yoki restart soni).

questions.question: Grafana transformations nima?
questions.explanation: Natijalarni render qilishdan oldin client tomonda o'zgartirish: jadvallarni join, maydonlarni qayta nomlash, filtrlash, farq hisoblash.

questions.question: Alertmanager klaster porti (9094) nima?
questions.explanation: Alertmanager node'lari orasida gossip uchun default TCP/UDP port.

questions.question: OTel Collector health_check extension nima?
questions.explanation: Kubernetes liveness/readiness probe'lari uchun HTTP health endpoint (default 13133).

questions.question: PromQL `deriv()` nima?
questions.explanation: Gauge'ning soniyalik o'zgarish tezligini oddiy chiziqli regressiya bilan hisoblaydi (counter uchun rate()).

questions.question: Grafana annotations nima?
questions.explanation: Grafiklar ustidagi vertikal belgilar — deploy, incident boshlanishi, chaos test kabi hodisalar (korrelyatsiya uchun juda foydali).

questions.question: Alertmanager silence matcher aniq va regex farqi.
questions.explanation: Silence label'larni aynan (=) yoki regex (=~) bilan moslaydi — regex silence ortiqcha kengayib ketishidan ehtiyot.

questions.question: OTel resource detector nima?
questions.explanation: Host muhiti metadata'sini (EC2 instance ID, GCP zona, container ID) avtomatik aniqlab telemetriyaga qo'shadi.

questions.question: PromQL `holt_winters()` nima?
questions.explanation: Double exponential smoothing bilan silliqlangan qiymat (yangi versiyalarda double_exponential_smoothing, eksperimental).

questions.question: Grafana playlist nima?
questions.explanation: NOC'dagi TV ekranlari uchun dashboard'larni belgilangan interval bilan avtomatik almashtirib ko'rsatish.

questions.question: Alertmanager email HTML template nima?
questions.explanation: Alert metadata'si va havolalar bilan moslashuvchan HTML email xabarlarini generatsiya qilish.

questions.question: OTel cumulative va delta temporality farqi.
questions.explanation: Cumulative: counter start'dan beri umumiy qiymat (Prometheus standarti).

questions.question: PromQL `days_in_month()` nima?
questions.explanation: Berilgan vaqtdagi oy necha kunligini qaytaradi — oylik hisob-kitoblar uchun.

questions.question: Grafana State Timeline paneli nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta pod yoki server uchun vaqt bo'yicha holat o'tishlarini (yashil — sog'lom, qizil — xato) vizualizatsiya qiladi.

questions.question: Alertmanager webhook retry nima?
questions.explanation: Webhook xabarini yetkazishda xato bo'lsa qayta urinishlar (Alertmanager ichki retry/backoff bilan, keyingi group_interval da ham qayta yuboradi).

questions.question: OTel exporter siqishi (`gzip`, `snappy`, `zstd`, `none`) qanday tanlanadi?
questions.explanation: Tarmoqda payload hajmini kamaytiradi; gzip — default va kuchli siqish, snappy/zstd — kam CPU bilan yuqori throughput. Tarmoq va CPU narxiga qarab tanlanadi.

questions.question: PromQL `hour()` nima?
questions.explanation: UTC bo'yicha soat (0–23) — alert'larni ish vaqti bilan cheklash uchun (vaqt zonasiga ehtiyot).

questions.question: Grafana flame graph paneli nima?
questions.explanation: Profil ma'lumotini (Pyroscope) ierarxik ko'rsatib, eng ko'p CPU yoki xotira ishlatayotgan funksiyalarni aniqlaydi.

questions.question: Alertmanager `--log.format=json` nima?
questions.explanation: Daemon log'larini markaziy yig'ish uchun strukturali JSON'da chiqaradi.

questions.question: OTel debug exporter nima?
questions.explanation: Telemetriya payload'ini lokal debug uchun stdout'ga chiqaradi (eski nomi logging exporter).

questions.question: PromQL `day_of_week()` nima?
questions.explanation: UTC bo'yicha hafta kuni (0 — yakshanba, 6 — shanba) — vaqtga bog'liq shartlar uchun.

questions.question: Grafana Geomap paneli nima?
questions.explanation: Geografik ma'lumotni xaritada ko'rsatadi — shaharlar bo'yicha trafik va latency.

questions.question: Enterprise observability maturity model qanday?
questions.explanation: Reaktiv monitoring: uptime ping va statik CPU/RAM chegaralari.
